hook: Your Moon landing map has India at the south pole.
title: India Landed Near the Moon's South Pole
description:
On 23 August 2023, Chandrayaan-3 touched down near the lunar south pole. The Pragyan rover then rolled out onto the surface. Part of the series: India In Space.

#Shorts #Chandrayaan3 #Moon

scenes.narration: Your Moon landing map has India at the south pole.
scenes.headline: INDIA ON THE MOON

scenes.narration: It landed near the Moon's south pole.
scenes.headline: NEAR THE SOUTH POLE

scenes.narration: Then a ramp opened on the lander.
scenes.headline: THE RAMP OPENS

scenes.narration: Its wheels left marks on the lunar dust.
scenes.headline: WHEEL TRACKS

scenes.narration: Few places on the Moon are harder to reach.
scenes.headline: HARD PLACE TO REACH

scenes.narration: India is at the south pole. Next: India's first Mars try.
scenes.headline: INDIA AT THE POLE
